dimensions.name: consistency
dimensions.criteria: 大纲与前提、角色、世界规则保持一致

dimensions.name: character
dimensions.criteria: 角色弧线清晰，动机与成长路径可信

dimensions.name: pacing
dimensions.criteria: 卷弧节奏分布合理，高潮与铺垫错落

dimensions.name: continuity
dimensions.criteria: 伏笔埋设与回收计划完整，跨卷线索连续

dimensions.name: foreshadow
dimensions.criteria: 长线悬念、伏笔与终局方向呼应

dimensions.name: hook
dimensions.criteria: 每章每弧留有牵引力，卷末钩子成立

dimensions.name: aesthetic
dimensions.criteria: 设定表达精炼，避免信息堆砌与模板化
